inputs.title: How a video gets made
inputs.slide_1_script: Every video starts as an idea: who it is for and what it should change.
inputs.slide_1_visual: a lightbulb above a small audience silhouette
inputs.slide_2_script: A blueprint locks the craft: timing, type, sound and transitions.
inputs.slide_2_visual: an architectural blueprint of a film strip
inputs.slide_3_script: Then any pipeline fills the slots, from local models to real footage.
inputs.slide_3_visual: interchangeable puzzle pieces clicking into a film reel
